placement: Capability Pack — src/capabilities/files/ with its own contract unit. Selection stays native: a real <input type=file> the user operates, reported as facts with opaque file ids (no File object crosses). The engine may ask to open a picker, which the browser allows only with user activation (NeedsGesture otherwise); reads are bounded slices, so a large file is read in chunks without loading it whole. Core unchanged; absent unless registered. The smoke runner gains trusted file-input and click actions.
